written_rules: Any combination of SCATTER symbols of 6 or more in active rows, except the SUPER SAW HARD HAT during the base game, triggers the FREE SPINS FEATURE and awards 6 free spins.
Before the FREE SPINS FEATURE begins, STRAW FRAME is added to the position of each triggering SCATTER symbol.

Before the FREE SPINS FEATURE begins and during each free spin, every HORIZONTAL SAW HARD HAT symbol in active rows generates a saw that moves left/right and every VERTICAL SAW HARD HAT symbol in active rows generates a saw that moves up/down until it exits the active grid.

conditions_triggers.SCATTER: 6 or more in active rows, except SUPER SAW HARD HAT during the base game
